text:
nina: Hey team — can we move the weekly triage from Wed 4pm to Tue 11am? Need earlier EMEA overlap and want room for RFC/design quick-checks. Propose 30m timebox + a 5m quick-RCA slot for any regressions. Thoughts?

sam: +1 Tue 11 works for me. Can we make it 35m though? We usually spill.

raj: leaning 30m to force async followups. Could do 30 but add a ‘parking lot’ doc for long items.

kelly: Works for me. Request: put a short "owner update" first (30s each) so we know who’s owning what.

leah: If we shift, someone needs to update calendar invites + rotation for note-taker. I can take next week.

deploy-bot: heads-up: infra deploy scheduled Tue 10:30am — might overlap if we do 11am and folks are on calls.

nina: Good catch @deploy-bot. Options: 11:30 (worse for EMEA) or keep 11 and ask infra to slide deploy earlier/later. Not ideal.

sam: How about keep Tue 11 but run a two-lane split: first 20m urgent bugs, last 10m backlog/owner updates. 30m total.

raj: I like that. Add a pre-triage checklist: owners tag issues + short summary link. I'll draft a template.

kelly: +1 add emoji shorthand for quick scan (:green_circle: :warning: :red_circle:) and a one-line cause if it's flaky.

nina: OK — plan: update invite to Tue 11-11:30, agenda: 1) owner quick updates (3m total), 2) urgent bug lane (20m), 3) backlog highlights & actions (7m), 4) notes & assignees. Note-taker rotates weekly; @leah will take next week.

leah: Confirmed — I'll take notes next week and publish in ops/triage/notes.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll update the pre-triage doc with the issues query and owner tagging instructions.

raj: Posting draft template now:
```
Title: Triage pre-read
Link: <issues-query>
Owners: @...
Priority filters: status:open label:bug sort:priority
Notes: add one-line symptom and probable owner
```
I'll open a PR in ~1h.

nina: Thanks all — if no objections I’ll change invites and add the agenda + template by EOD.
